lines.zh: 我沿着藤架走，尾羽扫落几片叶子。
lines.en: I walk along the trellis and my tail sweeps leaves down.

lines.zh: 我在花园的小径上踱步，一步一唱。
lines.en: I pace the garden path, one step and one note.

lines.zh: 我踩过花盆边缘，泥土沾在爪上。
lines.en: I step along a pot's rim and mud sticks to my claws.

lines.zh: 我走三步，就停下来哼一句。
lines.en: Every three steps I stop to hum a phrase.

lines.zh: 芒果色的羽毛在叶影里很显眼。
lines.en: My mango-colored feathers stand out among the leaf shadows.

lines.zh: 我从这一架藤荡到那一架藤。
lines.en: I swing from this trellis over to that one.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，怕碰掉刚开的花。
lines.en: I walk slowly, afraid of knocking off new flowers.

lines.zh: 我的爪抓不稳湿滑的石阶。
lines.en: My claws cannot grip the wet stone steps.

lines.zh: 我绕着水池走，水面映出我的颜色。
lines.en: I walk around the pool, which mirrors my color back.

lines.zh: 我跟在园丁后面，捡他漏下的种子。
lines.en: I follow the gardener and pick up the seeds he drops.

lines.zh: 风把花香吹来，我顺着走过去。
lines.en: The wind brings flower scent and I walk toward it.

lines.zh: 我穿过垂下的藤帘，歌声被叶子挡住。
lines.en: I pass through hanging vines and the leaves muffle my song.

lines.zh: 我站在枝上，把一首歌唱到一半。
lines.en: I stand on a branch with a song half finished.

lines.zh: 我理了理胸前的羽毛，颜色像熟芒果。
lines.en: I preen my breast feathers, ripe-mango colored.

lines.zh: 我停下来听，整座花园只有我的回声。
lines.en: I stop to listen; the whole garden holds only my echo.

lines.zh: 我把喙埋进翅下，打了个盹。
lines.en: I tuck my beak under my wing and doze.

lines.zh: 我轻轻哼着，调子跑了也不管。
lines.en: I hum softly and let the tune wander where it likes.

lines.zh: 一片叶子落下，我用喙接住。
lines.en: A leaf falls and I catch it on my beak.

lines.zh: 我歪头看花，看了很久。
lines.en: I tilt my head at a flower and look for a long time.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖尾羽，抖出几粒花粉。
lines.en: I shake my tail and a little pollen scatters.

lines.zh: 我闻到果香，那是从我自己身上来的。
lines.en: I smell fruit, and realize it comes from my own feathers.

lines.zh: 露水压弯了藤，我挪了挪脚。
lines.en: Dew weighs the vine down and I shift my feet.

lines.zh: 我对着水池唱，水里的那只也在唱。
lines.en: I sing to the pool and the one in the water sings back.

lines.zh: 我不唱的时候，花园显得太空。
lines.en: When I am not singing, the garden feels too empty.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，把下午睡过去一半。
lines.en: I blink slowly and sleep through half the afternoon.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收进腹羽，暖着。
lines.en: I draw my claws into my belly feathers to keep warm.

lines.zh: 我把调子压低，怕惊了花。
lines.en: I lower my tune so as not to startle the flowers.

lines.zh: 我梳了梳翅下的绒毛，很软。
lines.en: I preen the down under my wing. So soft.

lines.zh: 花园里没人，我照旧唱。
lines.en: No one is in the garden, and I sing anyway.

lines.zh: 我盯着藤上一只小虫，不动。
lines.en: I fix on a small bug on the vine and hold still.

lines.zh: 我停下歌，先看你带没带果子。
lines.en: I stop singing and check whether you brought fruit.

lines.zh: 我歪头，把你从帽子看到靴子。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look you over from hat to boots.

lines.zh: 你走近，我把身子往藤后缩了缩。
lines.en: You come closer and I shrink back behind the vine.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在芒果色的脸上很亮。
lines.en: My eyes are bright in my mango-colored face.

lines.zh: 我朝你叫了一个音，像在问你名字。
lines.en: I call one note at you, as if asking your name.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里常有种子。
lines.en: I stare at your hands, where seeds often are.

lines.zh: 你说话，我跟着学那个调子。
lines.en: You speak and I try to copy the tune of it.

lines.zh: 我跳到更低的枝上，好看清你。
lines.en: I hop to a lower branch to see you better.

lines.zh: 我抬喙，等你先动。
lines.en: I lift my beak and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我把这声音记下来。
lines.en: You laugh and I store that sound away.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走了半圈，又回到原处。
lines.en: I walk half a circle around you and return to my spot.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进花园，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across the garden and I do not care for it.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，歌声全乱了。
lines.en: I shriek once and my song falls apart.

lines.zh: 你打掉我几根羽毛，芒果色的。
lines.en: You knock out a few of my mango-colored feathers.

lines.zh: 我跳到藤的高处，翅膀还在抖。
lines.en: I leap to a high vine with my wings still shaking.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我闭上了喙。
lines.en: The blow hurts enough to shut my beak.

lines.zh: 我缩进叶子里，尾羽收得紧紧的。
lines.en: I shrink into the leaves with my tail pulled tight.

lines.zh: 我的翅被打歪，飞起来打转。
lines.en: My wing is knocked crooked and I fly in circles.

lines.zh: 我掉在花盆里，压坏了一株苗。
lines.en: I drop into a pot and crush a seedling.

lines.zh: 我不唱了，只发出低低的喉音。
lines.en: I stop singing and only growl low in my throat.

lines.zh: 血沾在羽毛上，颜色更深了。
lines.en: Blood on my feathers makes the color deeper.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，站都站不稳。
lines.en: I shake myself and cannot even stand steady.

lines.zh: 你手里的芒果，比我唱过的任何调子都甜。
lines.en: The mango in your hand is sweeter than any tune I know.

lines.zh: 我闻到果皮的味道，歌就断了。
lines.en: I smell the fruit skin and my song breaks off.

lines.zh: 你摇一摇果子，我便跳下藤架。
lines.en: You shake the fruit and I hop down from the trellis.

lines.zh: 熟透的果肉香，我隔着叶子也找得到。
lines.en: Ripe flesh smells through the leaves and I can find it.

lines.zh: 我落在你手腕上，只为了那颗果。
lines.en: I land on your wrist for that one fruit alone.

lines.zh: 你把果子举高，我就跟着飞一截。
lines.en: You raise the fruit and I flutter up a little after it.

lines.zh: 我不吃虫，只挑最软的果肉。
lines.en: I do not eat insects; I pick only the softest flesh.

lines.zh: 种子也行，我先把它们含在喙里。
lines.en: Seeds will do; I hold them in my beak first.

lines.zh: 果汁滴在石上，我低头去舔。
lines.en: Juice drips onto the stone and I bend to lap it up.

lines.zh: 你收回手，我就站在原地看着你。
lines.en: You pull your hand back and I stay where I am, watching.

lines.zh: 我撞在藤架上，掉下两片叶子。
lines.en: I hit the trellis and two leaves come down.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的尾羽，我立刻转身。
lines.en: You touch my tail feathers and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我从枝上滑下来，爪子勾住你的袖子。
lines.en: I slip off the branch and my claws catch your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，羽毛和花粉一起飞。
lines.en: We collide and feathers and pollen fly together.

lines.zh: 我的身体轻，撞你一下像丢了个果子。
lines.en: I am light; bumping you feels like dropping a fruit.

lines.zh: 你走过花架，正好撞歪我的窝。
lines.en: You walk past the arbor and knock my nest askew.

lines.zh: 我被挤得退了两步，才站稳。
lines.en: I am squeezed back two steps before I find my footing.

lines.zh: 我的喙碰到你的额头，凉的。
lines.en: My beak touches your forehead and it is cool.

lines.zh: 我们挤在窄藤上，谁也不肯让。
lines.en: We crowd onto one thin vine and neither gives way.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我从你的指缝间挤过去。
lines.en: You raise a hand and I squeeze between your fingers.

lines.zh: 我们一高一低地唱，调子慢慢合上。
lines.en: We sing high and low until our tunes fold together.

lines.zh: 它把最红的果子衔来给我。
lines.en: It brings me the reddest fruit it can find.

lines.zh: 我们在藤上并排站着，尾羽交叉。
lines.en: We stand side by side on the vine with tails crossed.

lines.zh: 它唱错了，我替它把那句接下去。
lines.en: It misses a note and I carry the phrase for it.

lines.zh: 我们一起理羽，谁也没停歌。
lines.en: We preen together and neither of us stops singing.

lines.zh: 它绕着我跳了一圈，翅膀半张。
lines.en: It dances once around me with wings half open.

lines.zh: 我们在花架深处筑了一个小窝。
lines.en: We build a small nest deep in the arbor.

lines.zh: 它靠过来，我把头搁在它颈边。
lines.en: It leans in and I rest my head against its neck.

lines.zh: 两只芒果色的影子在水里并着。
lines.en: Two mango-colored shadows lie side by side in the water.

lines.zh: 天黑后我们一起收声，只剩叶子响。
lines.en: After dark we both fall silent, and only leaves speak.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用喙衔着果子。
lines.en: I have no hands; I can only carry fruit in my beak.

lines.zh: 我叼起一颗种子，飞起来又掉了。
lines.en: I pick up a seed, take off, and lose it.

lines.zh: 落下的果子，我用爪子拨到窝边。
lines.en: I roll fallen fruit to the nest with my claws.

lines.zh: 我衔不住太多，一次只带一颗。
lines.en: I cannot hold much; one fruit per trip.

lines.zh: 我把果子藏在叶下，回头再吃。
lines.en: I hide the fruit under a leaf to eat later.

lines.zh: 这东西太重，我拖着走了两步。
lines.en: This thing is too heavy; I drag it two steps and stop.

lines.zh: 我试着用翅抱住它，抱不拢。
lines.en: I try to hold it with my wings and cannot close them.

lines.zh: 地上的碎果皮，我也啄两口。
lines.en: I peck at fruit peel on the ground as well.

lines.zh: 我把种子塞进藤缝，算是种下。
lines.en: I wedge a seed into a vine crack, which counts as planting.

lines.zh: 你递过来，我叼住就跑。
lines.en: You hold it out and I snatch it and run.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的花，我的歌停了。
lines.en: You crush my flowers and my song stops.

lines.zh: 我盯上你，因为你在摘我的果子。
lines.en: I fix on you because you are picking my fruit.

lines.zh: 有东西在藤下动，我把头压低。
lines.en: Something moves under the vine and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我锁住那只虫，翅膀绷紧。
lines.en: I lock onto that insect and my wings go taut.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，我就把你当成目标。
lines.en: You reach out and I count you as a target.

lines.zh: 我的叫声变短，那是警告。
lines.en: My calls grow short; that is a warning.

lines.zh: 这个目标闯进了花园，我不能不管。
lines.en: This one has entered the garden and I cannot ignore it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，那里踩着幼苗。
lines.en: I stare at your feet, which are on my seedlings.

lines.zh: 我把喙磨了磨，先看清距离。
lines.en: I whet my beak and judge the distance first.

lines.zh: 你退到藤架外，我才松开视线。
lines.en: You step outside the arbor and only then do I look away.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，从一架藤到另一架。
lines.en: I follow you from one trellis to the next.

lines.zh: 你在下面，我在上面，谁也没走开。
lines.en: You below and I above, and neither of us leaves.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，沿藤条慢慢挪。
lines.en: I flatten myself and creep along the vine.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就躲进叶子后面。
lines.en: You look back and I duck behind the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的歌声停了，只剩爪子抓藤的响。
lines.en: My song has stopped; only claws on vine remain.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，站在高处的枝上。
lines.en: I circle behind you and perch on a high branch.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我跟着挪一寸。
lines.en: For every step you take, I shift an inch.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那是最先动的地方。
lines.en: I watch your hands, where movement starts first.

lines.zh: 我飞到另一侧，把路挡住。
lines.en: I fly to the other side and block the way.

lines.zh: 我离你只有一根藤的距离。
lines.en: I am only one vine's length away from you.

lines.zh: 我扑下去啄你的手背，只啄了一下。
lines.en: I swoop and peck your hand once.

lines.zh: 我的喙敲在你指节上，像敲木。
lines.en: My beak raps your knuckles like wood.

lines.zh: 我张翅拍你的脸，羽毛扑了一身。
lines.en: I beat your face with open wings and feathers fly.

lines.zh: 我从高处冲下，撞在你肩上。
lines.en: I dive from above and hit your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我啄向你的眼睛，你偏头躲开。
lines.en: I peck at your eye and you turn your head aside.

lines.zh: 这一下啄空了，我落在花盆边。
lines.en: The peck misses and I land on a pot's edge.

lines.zh: 我用爪抓你的袖子，扯出线头。
lines.en: I claw your sleeve and pull out a thread.

lines.zh: 我连啄三下，你终于退开。
lines.en: I peck three times and you finally step back.

lines.zh: 我的喙不大，力气却比看上去足。
lines.en: My beak is small, but it hits harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 我打完就飞回藤上，继续唱。
lines.en: When it is done I fly back to the vine and resume singing.

lines.zh: 我从一颗熟芒果里钻出来，满身甜汁。
lines.en: I hatch out of a ripe mango, sticky with juice.

lines.zh: 我在空中花园醒来，头顶全是藤。
lines.en: I wake in the sky garden with vines overhead.

lines.zh: 第一声叫，是一句不成调的歌。
lines.en: My first call is a song with no tune yet.

lines.zh: 我从花盆的土里爬出，抖掉碎泥。
lines.en: I climb out of a pot's soil and shake off the crumbs.

lines.zh: 藤条把我托住，我就此留下。
lines.en: A vine holds me up, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我在露水里睁眼，先看见花。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the dew and see flowers first.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛一出生就是芒果色。
lines.en: My feathers are mango-colored from the day I hatch.

lines.zh: 我落进这座悬空的花园，爪子先着地。
lines.en: I drop into this hanging garden, claws first.

lines.zh: 我出生时唱了半句，然后饿了。
lines.en: I sing half a line at birth and then get hungry.

lines.zh: 花园里空着一个枝头，正好是我的。
lines.en: One branch in the garden stands empty, and it fits me.

lines.zh: 我从花苞里挣开，翅还是软的。
lines.en: I force my way out of a bud with wings still soft.

lines.zh: 风把我吹上藤架，我便住下了。
lines.en: The wind lifts me onto the trellis and there I settle.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到我的尾羽，焦味盖过花香。
lines.en: Flame licks my tail and the burnt smell drowns the flowers.

lines.zh: 我从藤架摔下来，落在石板上。
lines.en: I fall from the trellis and land on the flagstones.

lines.zh: 我掉进水池，羽毛吸满了水。
lines.en: I fall into the pool and my feathers soak up water.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻了花架，我被埋进叶子。
lines.en: The blast overturns the arbor and buries me in leaves.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的翅，羽毛落了一地。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing and feathers fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 药水泼上来，我的芒果色褪了一角。
lines.en: Potion splashes me and a corner of my mango color fades.

lines.zh: 果子吃完了，我的歌越来越轻。
lines.en: The fruit is gone and my song grows fainter.

lines.zh: 雷打中花架，我僵在枝上很久。
lines.en: Lightning hits the arbor and I freeze on the branch.

lines.zh: 花园在脚下消失，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: The garden vanishes beneath me and I keep falling.
